headline: HDFC Bank reports FY26 audited financial results and recommends final dividend of ₹13 per share
summary: HDFC Bank approved standalone and consolidated audited financial results for the quarter and year ended March 31, 2026, with an unmodified audit opinion. The Board recommended a final dividend of ₹13.00 per share, totaling ₹15.50 for the year, payable after shareholder approval at the AGM. The Board also approved fund raising of up to ₹60,000 crore via debt instruments and proposed amendments to the Employee Stock Incentive Scheme.
